accept: tetralogy of Fallot with outflow obstruction

findings: Right axis deviation with right ventricular hypertrophy

echoTasks.find: Malaligned ventricular septal defect with aortic override of the septum
Right ventricular outflow obstruction with a small pulmonary annulus and thick right ventricular wall
Thick walled dilated right ventricle with a dense high velocity tricuspid jet

auscultation.added: Single second sound with a loud aortic component
auscultation.murmur: Harsh ejection systolic murmur grade 3 of 6 at the upper left sternal edge

exam.general: 3 year old boy, central cyanosis with clubbing of fingers and toes, squats while playing
exam.other: Oxygen saturation 78 percent at rest, polycythaemia with haemoglobin 18 g per dl, no oedema
exam.precordium: Right ventricular heave at the left sternal edge, no thrill
exam.pulse: Regular 128, normal volume, all pulses felt

history.a: Blue lips noticed at 4 months, worsens with crying and exertion, squats of his own accord
history.q: When was blueness first seen and what helps

history.a: One spell of deep blue colour with limpness lasting minutes after prolonged crying last month
Eats slowly, weight gain poor, breathless when running with peers
Full term home delivery, cried late, no NICU stay
Second child, elder sister healthy, no consanguinity
Immunised to date, no prior echo, referred from a camp

keyPoints: Give oxygen during spells, knee chest positioning, and fluids, with beta blocker prophylaxis per paediatric cardiology advice
Correct anaemia with iron where deficient but avoid dehydration that worsens spells
Refer urgently to a paediatric cardiac centre for complete repair assessment
Counsel parents on spell first aid and endocarditis precautions before procedures
Track growth, haemoglobin and saturation at every visit while awaiting surgery
management.model: Spell prevention with positioning and beta blockade, anaemia and hydration care, and urgent referral for complete repair

sources: ASE guideline on echocardiography in adult congenital heart disease, in own words
Indian Academy of Paediatrics guidance on congenital heart disease referral, in own words
stem: A 3 year old boy from eastern Uttar Pradesh is brought for bluish lips since infancy, squatting episodes, and one recent hypercyanotic spell. He has central cyanosis with clubbing, a harsh outflow murmur, and a single second sound.
teaching: Squatting plus cyanosis plus an outflow murmur in a child is tetralogy of Fallot until proved otherwise
The four features are a malaligned defect, outflow obstruction, aortic override and right ventricular hypertrophy
A single second sound reflects the abnormal aortic alignment and pulmonary atresia spectrum physiology
Spells need knee chest positioning plus oxygen, then urgent surgical referral
title: Tetralogy of Fallot with severe obstruction in a preschool child
